errors.text: The proposed perturbation method is not clearly identified as direct MTP-to-DFT free-energy perturbation; Frenkel-Ladd and 'thermodynamic integration via small perturbations' do not actually reconstruct the targeted replacement of TI by FEP.

A 50 ps DFT molecular-dynamics trajectory by itself is not an ab initio free-energy or melting-temperature benchmark, so the proposed test cannot validate the claimed free-energy accuracy without an explicit DFT reference free-energy calculation.
The cited evidence does not support MTP accuracy, FEP convergence, the asserted two-orders-of-magnitude speedup, or the 2% melting-point accuracy threshold.
